name: Foreboding
description: A patrol hunting you shows how many steps its hunt has left.

name: Retrace
description: Undo your last march. You stand where it began and its days are restored. A march that ended on a site cannot be undone.

name: Auspice
description: Preview the corruption's next ground: nearby clean tiles pressed by corrupted neighbours are marked.

name: Stasis Snare
description: Freeze one visible patrol in place for the party's next 6 steps. Delay, not removal.
